summary: The Open Mobile Alliance defines a Push-to-talk over Cellular service that uses SIP for half-duplex media sessions and instant messages. This informational document defines a SIP event package and data format for publishing, subscribing to, and being notified about extra capabilities that service requires.

eli5.summary: Walkie-talkie service on phones needs to share certain settings. This defines a way for devices to post those settings and get updates when they change.

questions: sip event package for push-to-talk over cellular
